The T1 and T2 values by tumour type (histopathology) are only in scatter plots (Fig. 1 for T1, Fig. 3 for T2; median values are shown as bars without numerals). There is no table or sentence with the T1 or T2 of a tumour type, of white matter or of gray matter. Table 3 (printed page 502) has monoexponential T2 values (SD of the fit) of 10 SINGLE tumours that were selected because their T2 decay was biexponential (2 pituitary adenomas 396 and 337 ms, 2 craniopharyngiomas 260 and 366 ms, 1 meningioma 139 ms, 3 astrocytomas I-II 363, 180 and 155 ms, 2 astrocytomas III-IV 105 and 172 ms); these are not representative group values and I did not record them. I confirmed this on PDF pages 3 to 5.
